scope: Source-stated proposals, not implemented or experimentally confirmed capabilities.

feature_definitions.R: Computation result states its exact relation or guarantee.
feature_definitions.O: Fixed mathematical objects have certified representations or observations.
feature_definitions.G: Scoped guards compose without silently strengthening the intended meaning.
feature_definitions.V: Verified algorithms or checkers are distinguished from concrete execution authority and reification.
feature_definitions.D: Ordinary theorem and definition packages have separately identified operational policy.
feature_definitions.L: Providers use exact host targets; displayed edits replay exactly; negative outcomes retain their actual strength.
feature_definitions.P: Publication retains evidence and states its replay boundary.
feature_definitions.E: Evaluation shares assets with Lean, uses negative neighbors, and specifies measurable outcomes and stopping decisions.

rows.note: Exact relation strength belongs to the request/result, independently of evidence-production route.
rows.qualification: Proposal-level commitment; the companion is finite Python arithmetic, not implementation validation.
